  </section>
  <section v="16">

    <t s="11">And simply,</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Repentance done with joy perfects the subsequent Torah study and mitzvos, making them good and luminous.

translations.translation: And to add,
according to the known explanation
in the elucidation of the Sages’ phrase
“repentance and good deeds,”
that through repentance the deeds
(of the mitzvos)
are good and luminous,
it may be said,
that since repentance is with joy—for then repentance is in perfection—
through this there is increase in the joy and in the perfection of Torah study and fulfillment of mitzvos that follow repentance.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This effect of repentance on subsequent Torah and mitzvos is a preparation for the complete redemption, which will include the perfection of the people, the land, and the Torah.

translations.translation: And this matter
[the effect of repentance on Torah and mitzvos
(the service of the righteous)
that follow repentance]
is a proximate preparation for the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
who comes to bring the righteous to repentance.
And likewise regarding the future redemption, there will be these two matters,
as it is written,
“In returning and rest you shall be saved,”
“in returning” refers to the service of repentance,
and “in rest” refers to the service of the righteous.
And simply,
all of Israel,
“our young and our old, etc., our sons and our daughters”
[the perfection of the people],
will return to our holy land,
and as it is a good and spacious land
[the perfection of the land],
together with Torah and mitzvos
(the service of the righteous).
And since Torah and mitzvos are preceded by repentance,
even the Torah and mitzvos are in perfection
[the perfection of Torah and My mitzvos].
And all this—in the well-known phrase regarding repentance—“in one moment and in one instant.”
